research_question: Does the Phase161 typed template carry heldout predictive information beyond its selected topology and output boundary, or did a common graph shape alone produce the positive?

candidate.source: the single Phase161 selected template, unchanged
candidate.learned_constraint: node-output type equalities preserved across every training occurrence

controls.topology_only_ablation: same topology, external-input uses, and output boundary, with all learned type equalities removed
controls.node_output_boundary_ablation: same node count and output indices, without the selected external-input-use pattern or learned type equalities
controls.training_frequency_baseline: select one topology by highest training occurrence count among topologies spanning at least two training families, breaking ties by canonical digest
controls.exact_chain_fixed_controls: retain the Phase161 reported exact, chain, and supplied-fixed node counts

primary_endpoints.candidate_heldout_matches: heldout motifs accepted by the unchanged Phase161 template
primary_endpoints.topology_only_heldout_matches: heldout motifs accepted after removing only learned type equalities
primary_endpoints.typed_rejections: topology-only matches rejected by the learned type equalities
primary_endpoints.boundary_only_heldout_matches: heldout motifs with the same node count and output indices
primary_endpoints.frequency_baseline_heldout_matches: heldout motifs under the single training-frequency-selected topology
primary_endpoints.unseen_operator_pairs: candidate matches whose ordered target sequence did not occur for that topology in training
primary_endpoints.candidate_information_bits: negative log2 of candidate matches divided by topology-only matches, defined as zero when counts are equal

decision_rule.typed_informative_positive: candidate has at least one heldout match, rejects at least one topology-only heldout motif, and both implementations and hostile/resource gates pass
decision_rule.structural_only_valid_negative: candidate transfers but typed_rejections and candidate_information_bits are zero
decision_rule.infrastructure_failure: implementations disagree, split or source bindings change, hostile checks fail, or resource limits fail
